## Summary

Added `habit serve` — a zero-dependency local web server (Node's built-in `http`) that renders an HTML page listing every habit and its current streak.

- **`src/server.js`** (new): `renderPage()` builds the HTML (escapes habit names against injection), `createHabitServer()` returns an `http.Server` that serves it on every request.
- **`src/commands.js`**: extracted `habitsWithStreaks()` so both `list` (CLI) and the server share the same streak-computation path.
- **`src/cli.js`**: added a `serve [port]` command (default port 3000), printing the listening URL — kept printing in `cli.js` only, per repo convention.
- **`test/server.test.js`** (new): covers page rendering (with/without habits, HTML-escaping) and an end-to-end HTTP fetch against a live server.
- Updated `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` to document the new command and file.

Verified manually: `node src/cli.js add read && node src/cli.js done read && node src/cli.js serve 4173`, then `curl localhost:4173/` returned the expected table row. Full suite: 11/11 passing.
